flags.message: Decisive post-baseline forward signal used: on 2026-10-02 Justice Kavanaugh requested a response to application 26A446, due 2026-10-08. Observed on supremecourt.gov's page for the linked petition docket 26-391; the 26A446 page itself still showed only the Sep 29 submission entry when fetched. The frozen context (response_requested: false) is correct as at the arrival moment; the response-requested-increment claim is stated as near-certain on this basis. No disposition of the application surfaced.

The corpus service caps `fedcourts query --limit` at 500, so the applicant-class tally rests on the 86 substantive resolved rows among the 500 most recent application rows (Terms 2025-2026 only). An interim statpack cut by escalation signal and by applicant class (government vs. private, criminal vs. civil) would replace this ad hoc slice.
